the branch; the engine keeps the last message of that turn).

ReasoningEvent.description:
A model's thinking text, as it streams (ADR-0082 decision 6, ADR-0083). Only a turn that
asked for thinking has them (or a model that thinks whatever it is asked). It is shown
collapsed under "Thinking", stored as a `reasoning` part, and never sent back to the model as
context.
ReasoningEvent.title: ReasoningEvent

SaveTo.description:
The optional body of an export route: where to write. Without it the engine's own export
folder is used (the assistant has no Save As box to ask).

Web search as the chat box sees it (ADR-0083): whether the Search button is there, and
what pressing it first has to ask.

ToolCallEvent.description: The assistant is calling a tool (ADR-0057): `id` ties it to its `tool_result`.
ToolCallEvent.title: ToolCallEvent

ToolResultEvent.description:
A tool call finished. `output` is a small reference (an image id, search hits), never a
file: the window fetches the creation itself, with a fresh link.
ToolResultEvent.title: ToolResultEvent

WordsRequest.description: A recording of the library to write down: a track or a speech.

post.description:
A short clip from the chat box's microphone, written down. Nothing is saved: the clip is
held in memory for this request and the answer is the text alone (no creation, no library
row, no search entry, no log of the words). Only a 16 kHz mono 16-bit WAV of up to five
minutes is read (`dictation.inspect`); the speech model may stay in memory beside the chat
model when the two fit (`displaced` names whose model was unloaded when they did not).

post.description:
One passage of a chat reply, spoken. Nothing is saved: the text is held for this request
and the sound goes back in the answer (a WAV, base64), with no creation, no library row, no
search entry, no file and no log of the words. The text is turned into plain words and cut
at sentence ends (`read_aloud.passages`); ask for `part` 0, 1, 2 ... up to `parts`. The
speech model may stay in memory beside the chat model when the two fit (`displaced` names
whose model was unloaded when they did not).
